profile.headline: Integration and DevOps Engineer at ADT
profile.summary:
Integration Architect with 15+ years of experience on the integration space.  Also experienced on Web Development and J2EE technologies; Database Development, Modeling, and Administration; and System Analysis and Design.

Resourceful team worker with great interpersonal skills and experience working on the US (20+ years) and Brazil (5+ years). Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
